title: Reachable Lab Completion and Persistent Lab Runs

preflight.note: Registered before implementation in a clean isolated public worktree at exact base 927a57c9119d24581e8fe3fc1f1bd68e7ab1d0af after verifying WI324-WI329 were free. The shared dirty checkout, WI323 worktree, private repository, installed application, and preserved learner backup are out of scope.

acceptance_criteria.text: The authored lab flow has an accessible, reachable completion action after required reflection; completion evaluates authored requirements and does not auto-pass.
Lab run state hydrates from and persists to its envelope course entry through the WI324 owner, including pause/resume/reset behavior supported by the authored lab.
Public-neutral tests cover the full authored lab flow, validation failures, persistence, restart, and completion invariants without private course content.

source: Accepted persistence/state-authority discovery; implementation explicitly deferred from WI324.
